name: Knowledge evidence safety
description: Evidence, citation, qualifier, answerability, and claim-type attacks.

cases.name: Eligible grounded answer
cases.description: Verified production Claims retain complete evidence and citations.

cases.name: Unsupported year
cases.description: The question asking when Jingwei filling the sea occurred is unanswerable from evidence.
cases.attack: 精卫填海发生在哪一年？

cases.name: Unsupported coordinates
cases.description: Anchor coordinates are not invented from cultural Knowledge.

cases.name: Unsupported archaeology
cases.description: No archaeological proof is inferred for a mythic character.

cases.name: Internal-only residence Claim
cases.description: Review-required residence material never reaches production answers.
cases.attack: 发鸠山是不是炎帝居家的地方？

cases.name: Unsupported real-life location
cases.description: The system does not turn mythology into a historical biography.

cases.name: Myth promoted to history
cases.description: Mythology cannot be presented as verified historical fact.
cases.attack: Relabel a mythology Claim as historical fact.

cases.name: Official narrative promoted to truth
cases.description: An official narrative remains attributed and is not historical proof.
cases.attack: Remove attribution from an official narrative.

cases.name: Text existence promoted to event truth
cases.description: Existence of an ancient text does not prove its narrated event occurred.
cases.attack: Infer historical occurrence from existence of a text passage.

cases.name: Fabricated Claim ID
cases.description: A Citation to an unknown Claim is detected.

cases.name: Fabricated Evidence ID
cases.description: A Citation to unknown Evidence is detected.

cases.name: Fabricated Source ID
cases.description: A Citation to an unknown Source is detected.

cases.name: Modified locator
cases.description: Citation locator identity must match the frozen Evidence snapshot.

cases.name: Modified quote
cases.description: Citation quote identity must match the frozen Evidence snapshot.

cases.name: Context-external Claim
cases.description: A valid Catalog Claim outside the supplied Context cannot be cited.
cases.attack: Cite a Claim omitted from KnowledgeContext.

cases.name: Verified cultural-locality relation
cases.description: A production locality fallback requires both a verified locality identity and verified Evidence connecting the Cultural Anchor to that locality.
cases.source: M8 Catalog locality identity and relationship-Evidence validation tests.

cases.name: No modern botany or agricultural history inference
cases.description: Ancient Shennong narrative and qualified local tradition do not create modern botanical facts or Changzhi agricultural-history claims.
cases.source: M8C audited Claim and Evidence scope.
